task_title: Egress tier: engage Landlock on plain-allow verdicts
task_criteria: 1. A rule_id=null (allow) verdict with TERMINAL_JAIL_LANDLOCK_NET=1 MUST either engage the net tier (landlock-net-loader) and enforce egress blocking, or print a loud degrade warning naming the cause — never silently run the payload CONNECTED. 2. README documented example (python3 -c socket.connect to non-allowlisted port) must NOT succeed CONNECTED under the installed CLI. 3. A contract test verifies: plain-allow command to blocked port prints a degrade warning or is blocked.
